_meta.purpose: Labelled corpus for the content-honesty guard (scripts/check_form_template_honesty.py). Scores RECALL over defects known to be real and PRECISION over templates known to be correct.
_meta.why_precision_matters: A checker that flagged every ungated template would score recall 3/3 and be useless — it would condemn ANMELDUNG, whose ungated rule is correct because § 17 BMG applies to everyone, and eight legitimate non-EEA templates. Those clean cases are the reason this is a corpus and not an assertion.
_meta.grows_when: the next defect of this class is found — each becomes a permanent regression case, which is the mechanism that stops us re-finding the same thing by eye
_meta.cases_are_shapes_not_live_rows: Each case carries the trigger_rules shape as seeded, so a later forward migration fixing production does not invalidate the corpus.

cases.name: Residence permit appointment (Auslaenderbehoerde)
cases.label: violation
cases.reason: FreizuegG/EU § 2(4) — an EU citizen requires no residence title, and the old Freizuegigkeitsbescheinigung was abolished. Fields demand a biometric photo and the passport original for a document that cannot be issued to them. Fixed by 20261023000000; the pre-fix shape is kept here as a regression case.

cases.name: Family reunion visa - spouse (Familiennachzug)
cases.label: violation
cases.reason: Familiennachzug is a third-country-national procedure. A spouse of an EU citizen exercising free movement holds derived rights under FreizuegG/EU § 3 and needs no family reunion visa. Fires on roadmap.profile_completed, earlier in the journey than RESID-PERMIT-DE.

cases.name: Family reunion visa - minor child (Familiennachzug)
cases.label: violation
cases.reason: As FAM-SPOUSE — derived free-movement rights under FreizuegG/EU § 3 cover a minor child, so no family reunion visa exists for them.

cases.name: Address registration (Anmeldung beim Buergeramt)
cases.label: clean
cases.reason: § 17 BMG requires anyone moving into a German dwelling to register within two weeks, regardless of nationality. Ungated is CORRECT — gating it would drop the one real German arrival obligation. This is the case that stops the guard being a blanket ungated-template detector.

cases.name: EU Blue Card / residence title (Aufenthaltstitel)
cases.label: clean
cases.reason: Permit-like AND on an EEA destination, but declares visa_type skilled_worker, which _build_context cannot produce on an EEA corridor. Unsatisfiable by an EEA free-mover by construction — it looks wrong and is right.

cases.name: Dependent visa - spouse (derivative)
cases.label: clean
cases.reason: Permit-like and ungated, but the destination is US. visa_type is eea_registration only when BOTH countries are EEA, so this rule is unreachable by an EEA free-mover. One of eight such templates (BRP-COLLECT, DEP-*, JP-*, US-*) that must NOT be 'fixed'.

cases.name: Personal Relocation Data Sheet (France to Norway)
cases.label: clean
cases.reason: Explicitly gated on visa_type eea_registration — it is FOR EEA free-movers — and it is a data sheet, not a permit. The invariant must not catch the one thing we deliberately built for this corridor.
